title: State of Tamil Nadu through CBI v. Nalini & 25 Ors. (Rajiv Gandhi Assassination)
crime_type: Human Suicide Bombing / Terrorist Conspiracy / Political Assassination
court_or_authority: Supreme Court of India / TADA Designated Court Chennai
source: Supreme Court of India Judgment & Indian Kanoon (doc/1359141)
evidence: Haribabu camera film recovered intact from blast scene showing Dhanu with sandalwood garland advancing towards the Prime Minister
Fragments of denim vest containing RDX explosive pockets and steel ball pellets embedded in victim bodies
9-volt Golden Power batteries used to power dual toggle switches recovered from blast epicentre
Cipher wireless intercepts between LTTE leader Pottu Amman and operational cells in Tamil Nadu
modus_operandi: Suicide bomber wearing a concealed denim jacket loaded with RDX pellets and connected to dual toggle trigger switches infiltrated the VIP security enclosure at an election rally under the guise of offering a floral garland. Detonated the vest while bending to touch the former Prime Minister feet.
personality_disorder: Cultic militant fanatical devotion, ideological suicide conditioning, and cold detachment from collateral loss.
common_traits: Pioneering urban use of female suicide belt bomb
Integration of steel ball bearings for fragmentation lethality
Extensive dry runs at public political gatherings
Cyanide capsule necklaces worn by operatives to avoid capture
summary: Landmark assassination of former Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi. Supreme Court bench led by Justice K.T. Thomas analyzed circumstantial conspiracy under Section 10 of Indian Evidence Act and established forensic standards for blast reconstruction.
